title: Write the Words Again
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Jeremiah said the Lord's own words,
And Baruch wrote them down;
He rolled the scroll up long and tight
And read it to the town.

[Chorus]
Oh, write the words, oh, write them twice,
Dear Baruch, take your pen!
A king can burn a scroll of words,
The Lord says, "Write again!"

[Verse 2]
The king sat by his winter fire
And did not like the sound;
He cut the scroll and burned it up
Till not a word was found.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
But words the Lord has spoken out
Are stronger than a flame;
He told His prophet, "Take a scroll
And write them all the same."

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So Baruch wrote them, every one,
And added more words too;
When something you have made falls down,
Be brave and start anew!

[Chorus]
mood: Writing music. A steady, even stroke under the voice, like a pen moving across a page line after line and not stopping. Nylon guitar keeping the stroke, a cello answering low and sure after each line, the two in conversation. Brave rather than sad, and a shade brighter at the end, as if the last line is written in a bigger hand.
